item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.3.3.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.3.3/Leise-2.3.3.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.3.3
- **Leise asks for the microphone again whenever macOS has no answer on file.** After its first request, Leise used to remember "already asked" and never ask again — even when macOS had recorded no decision, which left no Leise entry in System Settings to switch on and pointed you at a dead end. Reinstalling didn't help, because that memory outlived the app. Leise now reads the microphone state from macOS every time: if nothing is decided yet, dictating (or the button on the Home page, the menu bar or the setup guide) brings up the system's own "Allow microphone" dialog; if access was declined, it opens the right page in System Settings, where Leise is listed; if a device-management or Screen Time policy blocks it, it says so.
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** (on-device polishing additionally needs a newer macOS with Apple Intelligence; without it Leise Engine uses its bundled model) · about **5–7 GB free disk** (app + speech models; 2.1 GB less when your Mac's built-in intelligence does the polishing).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
